verses.1: And the people saw that Moses was about to descend from the mountain. So they gathered around Aaron and said to him, “Stand up! Make us gods who will go before us, for this Moses is not known to us as a man who could save us from Egypt.”
verses.2: And Aaron said to them, “Take away the gold ornaments that are in your ears, both you and your daughters. Bring them to me.”
verses.3: And all the people took out the gold rings that were in their ears, and brought them to Ahron.
verses.4: And he took them by the hand, formed them into a wheel, and made them into a sacred vessel. Then he said, “These are your gods, Israel! They were brought to you from the land of Egypt.”
verses.5: And Aaron saw that there was a altar before him. So he called out to Aaron, “May the LORD be blessed from now on.”
verses.6: And they got up from their seats in the morning. They went up to the hill, and then they sat down to eat and drink. After that, they stood up again to sing.
verses.7: And the LORD said to Moses, “Go and strike the people of Israel, for they have sinned against you. They have rebelled against you after you brought them out of Egypt.”
verses.8: They quickly left the path that they were ordered to follow. They made an idol of it, and they worshipped it. They said, “These are your gods, O Israel, who brought you out of Egypt.”
verses.9: And the LORD said to Moses, “I have seen this people. They are a hard-to-please people.”
verses.10: And now, let me take them and eat them. Then I will make you into a great nation.
verses.11: And Moses faced before the face of his God. He said, “Why should God punish you among your people, after you have come out of Egypt with great power and strong hands?”
verses.12: Why should the Egyptians say, “Iniquity has brought them into this situation of being killed in the mountains. They are scattered over the land again from your hands. May you weep for the evil that has befallen your people.”
verses.13: A reminder of Abraham, Isaac, and Israel, your servants. You swore to them with your word, and you promised them that all of this land would be given to their descendants forever.
verses.14: And Jehovah comforted him regarding the evil that he had spoken about doing to his people.
verses.15: And Moses descended from the mountain. In his hands were two tablets, on which were written the stories of their lives, from one side to the other.
verses.16: And these writings are the work of God. And the writing itself is a creation of God’s hand. It is a masterpiece of divine craftsmanship.
verses.17: And Joshua heard the sound of the people’s voices, filled with anger. He said to Moses, “There is a sound of fighting in the camp.”
verses.18: And he said, “There is no sound of sorrow from the powerful; there is also no sound of sorrow from the weak. My voice alone is the voice of sorrow.”
verses.19: And when he arrived at the camp, he saw the donkey and its rider. He picked up Moses’ beard with his hands and threw them down under the mountain.
verses.20: And he took the calf that they had made, and burned it in fire. Then he set it aside until it was dry. After that, he threw it into the water, and then he sprinkled it on the children of Israel.
verses.21: And Moses said to Aaron, “What has this people done to you? They have brought upon you a great sin.”
verses.22: And Aaron said to Israel, “You know well that this people are evil.”
verses.23: And they said to me, “Make for us gods who may go before us, for Moses is not the one we can trust; he doesn’t know what will happen to us.”
verses.24: And he said to them, “To whom has this gold been given? They gave it to me, and I will burn it in fire.” And then that calf came out.
verses.25: And Moses saw that the people were like Aaron’s people, who were like Pharaoh’s people.
verses.26: Moses stood at the gate of the camp and said, “Who is there to speak to Jehovah?” All the children of Levi gathered around him.
verses.27: And he said to them, “As the LORD, the God of Israel, says: Let one man put an end to another man’s life. Go from gate to gate in the camp, and kill each other. Let no man spare his brother or his neighbor.”
verses.28: And the sons of Levi did as Moses commanded them. On that day, three thousand men died from among the people.
verses.29: And Moses said, “Today, your hands are full of blood. For today, one of your children and his brother will be laid waste upon you. But today, I will bless you.”
verses.30: And in the evening, Moses said to the people, “You have sinned greatly. Now I will go up to Yahweh and atone for your sins.”
verses.31: And Moses stood before Jehovah and said, “This people has sinned greatly. They have made for themselves gods of gold.”
verses.32: And now, if you still carry your sins with you, and if there is anything that needs to be forgiven from your list of sins that you’ve written down… then please forgive me.
verses.33: And the LORD said to Moses, “Who has sinned against me that I should destroy them from among my people?”
verses.34: And now, go and lead the people to where I have spoken to you about. Now, behold, my angel will go before you. On that day, I will judge them and punish them for their sins.
verses.35: And Jehovah punished the people for having made the wheel that Ahron made.
